Methodology.title: How the score is built
Methodology.subtitle: 0–100 points across six weighted checks, recomputed continuously as each token trades. Nothing here is a black box.

security.title: Security
security.desc: Has the creator renounced mint authority? Do the top 10 wallets hold under 30–40% of supply? Is liquidity locked or burned? Serious red flags cut this score to near zero.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.desc: Can you actually sell? Pools under $1,000 score zero. Pools growing steadily toward $10,000–$30,000 score highest.

momentum.title: Momentum
momentum.desc: Buy and sell volume over the last five minutes, and the ratio of buyers to sellers. Broad, one-sided buying scores highest.

market.title: Market
market.desc: Trading volume and market-cap sanity checks — over $5,000 traded in five minutes scores 85–100%; zero volume scores 10%. Flags caps that dwarf real liquidity.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.desc: Has the creator already sold or emptied their wallet? Locking in profit early reads as a signal against a future rug pull, not against it.

data.title: Data quality
data.desc: A penalty for gaps in source data — for example, holder counts DexScreener couldn't return. Unknown risk is still risk.

Monitoring.title: Every token, the moment it's discovered
Monitoring.subtitle: No request required. PATROL finds it first — you just watch the ticker.

Growth.title: Passed audit. Up 50%+ from T0.
Growth.subtitle: Tokens move here automatically the instant they cross +50% from discovery — proof the filter isn't just theoretical.

Quarantine.title: Every rejection, stamped with its reason
Quarantine.subtitle: Nothing is hidden after the fact. The public archive of what PATROL turned away, and why.

About.desc_1: PATROL is built and maintained by the Center Digital Trust, a Ukrainian non-profit working to make trust verifiable rather than declared. It's the organization's second initiative alongside MD System, an evidentiary integrity platform for public institutions — both share one principle: transparent, non-custodial, on-chain verification, with no single point of failure and no authority to edit the record.
About.desc_2: An open, public API for wallets and DEX aggregators is planned as the next phase — so any project in the ecosystem can carry the same security score, without building an audit pipeline of its own.
About.org_network: Solana (core built to extend to other chains)
About.org_status: Paper-trading engine live · public web release in progress
